content: Ordered target statistics for ONE specified sample in a random permutation. Draw an ordered sequence of EXACTLY SIX example records with a category field and separate target field. Record categories in permutation are A, B, A, A, A, B; current example is record4 category A. Use blue same-category A and orange B consistently, BUT no letters/digits drawn. Records1 and3 (prefix AND same category) are the only target entries allowed to contribute to ONE statistic aggregator. Record2 is prefix but another category, so its target excluded. Current record4 own target must be excluded; records5,6 future targets excluded. Show past/current/future dividing guide and active vs muted target slots, not a datachart. Aggregator uses only record1+record3 target values plus prior smoothing, result arrow goes to CURRENT record4 encoded feature. No arrows from any other targets to statistic. Very clear direct dependencies and large empty category/target slots for actual typography, currentrecord highlight. External CatBoost figure only conveys ordered-prefix principle, do not copy ordered boosting residual mechanism.
